supplement.origin: Elsevier mmc1.docx for PII S2352550926000461, CC BY 4.0

evidence.wording: Supplementary A.1 lists every TPB and DIPB item verbatim; the OCR of A.10 shows the items as administered, including the 1-7 anchors.
evidence.timing: A.10 page order: person details, TPB block, DIPB block, conjoint task, post-conjoint labels, closing questions. Every fact item is answered before any product choice.
evidence.instrument: Paper section 3.2.2 and A.10: two products, three paired rounds, forced binary choice, then a separate purchase-likelihood rating.
evidence.price_levels: Table 1 CHF levels per product; the questionnaire displayed a coloured A-E impact scale whose exact letter-to-level assignment is not recoverable, so only the published level labels are used.

linkage.method: SEP rows follow ascending PubId; verified by recomputing eight published aggregates.

excluded_fields.reason: choice, rating, intention and any choice-derived score

limitations: The authors excluded speeders and registry mismatches; those flags are not in the released files, so the analysed sample cannot be reproduced exactly. The frame here is every respondent with valid choices and complete items.
envcon, envbeh and cfc exist only as precomputed indices in the release; they are not used because a standardised score cannot be turned into a faithful natural-language fact.
Paper text says jeans in one place and the data says Jacket; the data label is used and not harmonised.
The paper anchors the rating scale in the opposite direction to the questionnaire screenshot; ratings are excluded from model input, so this does not affect the experiment.
